idea.title: You don't need more listings
idea.angle: Most agents chase new listings when the ones they have are invisible. The fix isn't more money on ads; it's packaging the same listing so it gets noticed, understood and acted on.

slides.heading: YOUR LISTINGS ARE **INVISIBLE**
slides.body: Lots of listings, few messages. The problem is how they're packaged.

slides.heading: MORE ADS WON'T **FIX** IT
slides.body: Boosting a weak post just shows a weak post to more people.

slides.heading: GET IT **NOTICED**
slides.body: Lead with your best shot and a bold hook. Then a 15-second video.

slides.heading: GET IT **UNDERSTOOD**
slides.body: Show the basics: bedrooms, price and location. Don't make buyers ask.

slides.heading: GET IT **ACTED** ON
slides.body: Give one clear action, like a keyword or a WhatsApp link.

caption:
Chasing more listings won't fix a quiet inbox.

Most listings aren't bad. They're just not getting noticed.
Get each one noticed, understood and acted on.
Same listing. Better packaging. No extra ad spend.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: Lead with your best shot, not the gate
idea.angle: The first photo is your hook. Always lead with the single most impressive shot (pool, view, living room), even if it isn't the front of the house.
idea.hook: YOUR BEST SHOT GOES FIRST. ALWAYS.

slides.heading: YOUR FIRST PHOTO IS THE **HOOK**
slides.body: Buyers decide in about a second whether to keep looking.

slides.heading: FIND YOUR **HERO** SHOT
slides.body: The single most impressive photo. The pool, the view or the living room.

slides.heading: PUT IT **FIRST**
slides.body: Even if it isn't the front of the house. The gate can wait.

slides.heading: KEEP THE REST IN **ORDER**
slides.body: Main rooms next. Standout feature and neighbourhood at the end.

slides.heading: SAME PHOTOS. NEW **FIRST** PHOTO.
slides.body:
Before: Front gate first. The pool is photo 14.
After:
✓ The pool first
✓ Living room and kitchen next
✓ Neighbourhood last

caption:
The front gate is not your best photo. So why is it first?

Your first photo is your hook.
Lead with the pool, the view or the living room, even if it isn't the front.
One small change. No new photos needed.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: Myth: AI listing videos look fake
idea.angle: AI only looks fake when it invents things. Done honestly, it moves through your real rooms, with no added furniture, rooms or views, so buyers see the home they will visit.
idea.hook: "AI VIDEOS LOOK FAKE." NOT IF DONE RIGHT.

slides.heading: AI VIDEOS LOOK **FAKE**? NOT IF DONE RIGHT.
BUYERS WILL FEEL MISLED BY AI
IT LOOKS FAKE WHEN IT **INVENTS**
slides.body: Added furniture, extra rooms, a view that isn't there. That's where trust breaks.

slides.heading: DONE RIGHT, IT'S YOUR **REAL** HOME
slides.body: AI turns your real photos into smooth video. The same rooms buyers will visit.

slides.heading: ADD **NOTHING** FAKE
slides.body: No new furniture, rooms or views. Make it look good, keep it honest.

slides.heading: SLOW, **SMOOTH** MOVES
slides.body: Two to three seconds per shot. Calm camera moves through real rooms.

slides.heading: IT HELPS YOU. IT DOESN'T **REPLACE** YOU.
slides.body: You still know the home and the buyer. AI just saves the filming.

caption:
AI listing videos only look fake when they fake the house.

Done right, AI turns your real photos into smooth video.
No added furniture. No extra rooms. No borrowed views.
Buyers see the home they will actually visit.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: Pick the 3 highlights buyers care about
idea.angle: Buyers of a family house care about different things than renters of a city flat. Choose the three things buyers of that home care about most (security, kitchen, road access) and put them in the caption.

slides.heading: THE MORE YOU LIST, THE BETTER
BUYERS WANT **FACTS**, NOT ADJECTIVES
slides.body: "Spacious" and "beautiful" tell them nothing they can check.

slides.heading: KNOW WHO'S **BUYING**
slides.body: A family buying a house wants different things than someone renting a city flat.

slides.heading: PICK THEIR **TOP** THREE
slides.body: Family home: security, kitchen, road access. City flat: transport, parking, a lift.

slides.heading: PUT THEM ON **LINE** THREE
slides.body: Hook, basics, three highlights, price and location, one action.

slides.heading: SAME HOUSE. **SHARPER** CAPTION.
slides.body:
Before: Beautiful, spacious, very nice house. Must see.
After:
✓ Gated, 24-hour security
✓ Fitted kitchen
✓ 5 minutes to the main road

slides.heading: THREE LINES BUYERS **READ**
slides.body: Save this for your next listing caption.

caption:
Fifteen adjectives. Zero messages.

"Spacious" and "beautiful" tell buyers nothing they can check.
Pick the three things buyers of that home care about most.
Put them on line three of your caption, one per line.

Save this for your next listing caption.

idea.title: No hook: your first slide says nothing
idea.angle: Nothing in the first moment says why this home is worth their time. A hook names the size or the standout feature, like '4-bed with a pool'.
idea.hook: "NICE HOUSE FOR SALE" IS NOT A HOOK

slides.heading: "NICE HOUSE FOR SALE" IS NOT A **HOOK**
BUYERS DECIDE IN ABOUT A **SECOND**
slides.body: If the first moment doesn't say why, they keep scrolling.

slides.heading: A HOOK SAYS **WHY** THIS HOME
slides.body: Name the size, the area or the standout feature. In one line.

slides.heading: LEAD WITH THE **SIZE**
slides.body: "4-bed" tells a buyer in a second if it fits their family.

slides.heading: ADD THE **STANDOUT** FEATURE
slides.body: Pool, garden, view. The one thing that makes this home different.

slides.heading: SAME HOUSE. A **REAL** HOOK.
slides.body:
Before: Nice house for sale.
After:
✓ "4-bed with pool, quiet street"
✓ Bold text on your best shot
✓ Easy to read with the sound off

caption:
"Nice house for sale" gives nobody a reason to stop.

Buyers decide in about a second whether to keep looking.
Your hook names the size or the standout feature.
Try "4-bed with pool, quiet street" in bold text on your best shot.
